rationale: No spec/story was in scope (acceptance lens n/a), which caps confidence at low regardless of findings; blind and verification-gap were correctly skipped under the balanced profile. Standards review found 1 blocking commit-format violation (coverage_gap false). Edge-case lens produced 5 candidates: 2 are real regressions introduced by this concurrency rebase (a fatal custom build now discards already-built builtin handles without cleanup; an unguarded version-pin call now crashes the whole subagent batch instead of being skipped) and 3 were dismissed as noise (BaseException-vs-Exception handling in _timed_call is a pre-existing pattern and purely theoretical here; the best-effort cancel() semantics are already documented in run_builds's own docstring; the lack of a hard SUBAGENT_BUILD_MAX_WORKERS ceiling is already documented as an operator tuning tradeoff in config.py). No decision_needed items, no deferred items.

findings.title: Commit subject breaks ticket-prefix convention
findings.problem: Commit subject uses a lowercase branch-slug prefix instead of the required 'EPMCDME-####: Description' format mandated by git-workflow.md.
findings.impact: Breaks the documented commit-message convention this repo enforces for every commit, which blocks the merge workflow.
findings.recommendation: Reword the subject to 'EPMCDME-15952: Add planning artifacts' (or squash it into an adjacent EPMCDME-15952-prefixed commit) before merge.

findings.title: Fatal custom failure drops already-built builtin handles
findings.problem: collect_custom_executors re-raises immediately on a fatal MCPToolLoadException from a custom sub-assistant, before the builtin-handle loop below it runs. Because run_builds executes custom and builtin jobs concurrently on one shared pool (previously builtins were only ever attempted after every custom build had already succeeded), a builtin job positioned later in the submission list can already have completed successfully by the time the fatal outcome is detected.
findings.impact: The already-built builtin SubagentHandle objects, and whatever resources their build opened, are discarded without being closed or reused; this ordering was impossible before this change serialized builtins strictly after all customs, so the leak is newly introduced.
findings.recommendation: Before re-raising in collect_custom_executors (or at the call site in create_subagent_executors), close/release any already-succeeded outcomes in outcomes[len(custom_assistants):] instead of discarding them silently.

findings.title: Version-pin failure now aborts the whole subagent batch
findings.problem: prepare_assistants calls _with_pinned_version outside any try/except. AssistantVersionService.apply_version_to_assistant is documented to raise ExtendedHTTPException when the version is not found, and can also raise from ensure_no_personal_integration_if_shared. Previously this call sat inside the per-assistant try/except in create_assistant_executors that caught Exception, logged, and continued with the remaining sub-assistants.
findings.impact: One sub-assistant with a stale or invalid version pin now crashes prepare_assistants and the whole create_subagent_executors call for the request, instead of being skipped while its siblings and all builtin subagents still build.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the _with_pinned_version call in prepare_assistants's loop in a try/except Exception that logs and skips that assistant, matching the prior per-assistant degradation behavior.

standards_review.notes: 13 of 14 commit subjects match 'EPMCDME-####: Description'; 'epmcdme-15952-concurrent-subagent-executors: add planning artifacts' uses a lowercase branch-slug prefix instead.

New run_builds/_pooled_call/_timed_call/custom_build_jobs code uses modern typing, the bounded runner lives alongside the executor-building code it serves, and all changed files stay well under the Module Cohesion threshold.

_pooled_call clears the ambient DB session before running a build job in its own copied context; _build_builtin_subagent_executor deepcopies toolkits/mcp_servers/context before concurrent builtin builds; no credentials in new log statements.
